digest.title: Owner daily digest
digest.intro: Every morning's e-mail, previewed: yesterday's shipped and late orders, new orders, work stuck, alerts and approvals waiting.
digest.failed: The morning e-mail could not be read.

held.off: Your morning e-mail is off: turn it on with Edit.
held.mailOff: The morning e-mail of this company is switched off: the owner switches it on.
held.testMailOff: No company it covers has its morning e-mail switched on: the owner switches it on first.
held.offline: Offline: try again when back online.
held.time: Write a time of day as HH:MM.

next.none: Not planned while it does not go out

digest.never: Figures per company, line and order, never per person. Money only with your rights.

form.label: Morning e-mail settings
form.enabled: Send me this e-mail every morning
form.enabledOn: It goes out every morning (while the company's morning e-mail is switched on).
form.enabledOff: Off: nothing is sent to you.
form.companyHint: All your companies lists only those whose morning e-mail is switched on.

preview.title: Preview of today's e-mail
preview.mail: The e-mail as it would go out
preview.failed: The preview could not be read.
preview.notSent: Nothing goes out today: no company it covers has its morning e-mail switched on. This is what it would say.
preview.leftOut: Left out because of your rights: {sections}.

switch.title: The morning e-mail of each company
switch.intro: Off until you switch it on: while a company's switch is off, nobody gets its morning e-mail, whoever turned theirs on.
switch.label: Morning e-mail of {company}

recipients.title: Who gets it
recipients.none: Nobody has turned the morning e-mail on yet.

done.savedOn: Saved: your morning e-mail is on.
done.savedOff: Saved: your morning e-mail is off.
done.switchOn: The morning e-mail of {company} is switched on.
done.switchOff: The morning e-mail of {company} is switched off.

error.forbidden: This is not in your role.
error.offline: The factory API could not be reached.
error.stale: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again. Check it and save once more.
error.invalid: Some settings are not valid: check the time, the weekdays and the sections.
error.mailOff: The morning e-mail of this company is switched off: the owner switches it on first, then a test can go out.
error.notSent: The test could not be sent: there is no verified sending address, or your address refuses mail.

emailMe.title: E-mail me this
emailMe.intro: Get this report by e-mail on the days and at the time you choose, with the filters below. It is run as you, with your rights, and sent to you only.
emailMe.failed: Your e-mail of this report could not be read.
emailMe.rights: Each e-mail runs the report again with your rights at that moment: what you may no longer see is not sent.

held.time: Write a time of day as HH:MM.

done.subscribed: Done: this report will come to you by e-mail.
done.paused: Paused: nothing is sent until you resume it.
done.stopped: Stopped: you no longer get this report by e-mail.

error.stale: It changed in another window: it was read again. Check it and save once more.
error.forbidden: You cannot run this report, so it cannot be e-mailed to you.
error.offline: The factory API could not be reached.
error.invalid: Some settings are not valid: check the time, the weekdays and the filters.
error.ownMail: This report is e-mailed from its own page (Production › Reports).

wip.title: WIP ageing
wip.intro: Garments waiting at each stage and how long since their work order was last reported, by line, at {site}. Now: no history of stages is kept.
wip.failed: The work in progress could not be read.
wip.empty: Nothing is waiting at any stage.
wip.emptyBody: No work order in work has garments waiting at a stage now.
wip.overall: {workOrders} work orders in work · {waiting} garments waiting
wip.foot: Days since the work order's last report (else its start, else its release). Per line and stage, never per person or station.

error.forbidden: The work in progress is not in your role.
error.offline: The factory API could not be reached.

flowValue.title: Value at cost
flowValue.label: The work orders' value at cost per stage
flowValue.mixed: Value at cost: the companies keep different currencies, so no single amount is shown.
flowValue.partial: Only the first 5000 work orders are counted.
flowValue.error: The value at cost could not be read.

routes.title: Goes to, by place
routes.intro: Who this rule tells at a company, a site, a line or a customer: the holders of a role there, or one person. An alert of a place a route covers goes to the routes' people.
routes.elsewhere: Elsewhere the rule tells its own role, as its sentence says.
routes.ruleRole: Without a route the rule tells its own role, as its sentence says.
routes.readOnly: You may read the routes; changing them needs the right to keep the rules of this place.
routes.noPlaces: No place inside this rule to route.
routes.customersCut: Only the first 500 customers by name are listed.

held.offline: Offline: try again when back online.
held.tooMany: A rule keeps at most {max} routes.

error.save: Couldn't save the route. Try again.

error.duplicate: This rule already tells them at that place.
